name: Crusades
description: From Antioch to Jerusalem and back again: two hundred years of war for the Holy Land.

events.text: Kerbogha of Mosul marches to relieve Antioch with a great army.

mission.history: The armies of the First Crusade have crossed Anatolia, through heat, thirst and the Turks' horse archers, and come down to the walls of Antioch, the greatest city of Syria.
mission.briefing: Take Antioch and its port, St Simeon, before Kerbogha arrives.
mission.victory_text: Antioch falls, and the crusaders find the Holy Lance under the floor of St Peter's.
mission.defeat_text: Marash falls, and the crusade dies in the hills.

mission.history: Baldwin of Boulogne has left the main army and ridden east to the Euphrates, where the Armenian lord of Edessa has asked for his help.
mission.briefing: Make Edessa and the Euphrates crossing at Bira the first crusader state.
mission.victory_text: Baldwin is Count of Edessa, the first of the crusader states.
mission.defeat_text: Antioch falls, and Baldwin's adventure ends.

mission.history: Three years after leaving home, the crusaders march down the coast towards Jerusalem, which the Fatimids of Egypt took from the Turks only last year.
mission.briefing: Take the Holy City before Egypt sends an army to save it.
mission.victory_text: On 15 July the crusaders storm the walls of Jerusalem.
mission.defeat_text: Antioch falls behind you, and the crusade never reaches Jerusalem.

events.text: The vizier al-Afdal has landed at Ascalon with the army of Egypt.

mission.history: Jerusalem is taken, but the vizier of Egypt is coming to take it back, and most of the crusaders want to go home.
mission.briefing: March out and destroy the Egyptian army before it reaches Jerusalem.
mission.victory_text: The Egyptian camp is taken at dawn, and the kingdom of Jerusalem will live.
mission.defeat_text: Jerusalem falls back to Egypt within the year.

mission.history: Tripoli has held out against the crusaders for five years behind its sea walls. Bertrand of Toulouse has come from the West to claim his father's conquest.
mission.briefing: Take Tripoli and found the fourth crusader state.
mission.victory_text: Tripoli surrenders, and the County of Tripoli is born.
mission.defeat_text: Antioch falls while the army is held before Tripoli.

mission.history: A Venetian fleet has destroyed the Egyptian navy off Ascalon. Now Venice and the kingdom lay siege to Tyre, the strongest city on the coast.
mission.briefing: Take Tyre while the Venetians hold the sea.
mission.victory_text: Tyre surrenders after five months. The whole coast north of Ascalon is in Christian hands.
mission.defeat_text: Acre falls, and the siege of Tyre is abandoned.

mission.history: Count Joscelin II has taken his army west, and Zengi, atabeg of Mosul and Aleppo, has seized the moment to strike at Edessa.
mission.briefing: Hold Edessa until help comes. History says it falls.
mission.victory_text: Zengi's army falls back from the walls, and Edessa stands.
mission.defeat_text: Edessa falls on Christmas Eve, and Europe takes the cross again.

mission.history: The Second Crusade has come, led by the kings of France and Germany. Instead of Edessa, the barons have chosen Damascus, the richest city of Syria.
mission.briefing: Take Damascus before Nur ad-Din comes down from Aleppo.
mission.victory_text: Damascus falls, and the Second Crusade is not wasted after all.
mission.defeat_text: Jerusalem falls while its army is away.

mission.history: Ascalon, the bride of Syria, is the last Egyptian fortress on the coast. Every year its garrison raids the kingdom. King Baldwin III has brought siege towers.
mission.briefing: Take Ascalon and close the road from Egypt.
mission.victory_text: Ascalon falls after seven months, and the whole coast is in crusader hands.
mission.defeat_text: Jerusalem falls while the army is at Ascalon.

events.text: Saladin crosses the Sinai with the army of Egypt.

mission.history: King Baldwin IV is sixteen and a leper. Saladin has marched out of Egypt and the king's army is shut up in Ascalon, with the road to Jerusalem open.
mission.briefing: Catch Saladin's army on the march and destroy his Mamluks.
mission.victory_text: At Montgisard the boy king's knights scatter Saladin's army.
mission.defeat_text: Jerusalem falls to Saladin ten years early.

events.text: Saladin's host gathers on the Golan heights above the Sea of Galilee.

mission.history: Reynald of Châtillon has broken the truce. Saladin has gathered the largest army the kingdom has ever faced, and King Guy is marching to meet it across the waterless hills.
mission.briefing: History says Jerusalem falls this year. Keep it.
mission.victory_text: Saladin's host melts away, and Jerusalem is still a Christian city.
mission.defeat_text: Jerusalem falls to Saladin, as it did in 1187.

additional.text: Take Paphos and hold it for 2 turns
Take Lefkosa and hold it for 2 turns

mission.history: The Christian states in the East hang by a thread. The emperor Frederick Barbarossa has drowned on the way, and Richard the Lionheart and Philip of France quarrel over Cyprus, but the crusade is still strong, and Saladin has lost many men.
mission.briefing: Take Acre and Jerusalem. Cyprus will keep the crusade supplied.
mission.victory_text: Acre and Jerusalem are taken. The Third Crusade has done what the Second could not.
mission.defeat_text: The crusade melts away, and Richard sails home.
